cells.rationale: The 2026-10-17 first print was 194,000, the lowest since July, after first prints of 197,000 (Oct 3) and 199,000 (Oct 10) and a 4-week average of 197,750 (macrobullseye, 2026-10-22, quotes checked), so the 194,000 threshold sits at the bottom of the recent 194,000-200,000 range. A week-to-week move of 5,000-10,000 is common and a print at the lowest level in three months tends to be followed by a partial rebound; secondary-source consensus for the week ending Oct 24 is about 196,000 (Trading Economics, not confirmed). The statistical baseline (0.44) treats the latest value as the median, but the recent mean is higher, so I lean above it; the threshold is a strict 'above', so an exact 194,000 print resolves No.

note: Recorded before every entry's cutoff; scored as a separate method.
